blocks.text: It senses only metallic objects; Useful for medium counting speed; Short sensing gaps. These switches are ideally suitable for level monitoring applications. The sensing range can be from 0.2 m to 20 meters. These sensors have the ability to perform in dry and dusty environments. These sensors are immune to electrical noise levels generally present in the typical industrial environment. The ultrasonic sensors find applications for Anti-collision detection for cranes, Level controller for liquids and solids, Detection of moving object, Opening / Closing of doors by detecting motion.

Jayashree Diaphragm Type Bin Monitor offers economical, reliable and durable point level controls for point level detection of dry bulk materials. The units can be used to eliminate bin overflow, maintain a pre-determined material level, indicate plugging of chutes or conveyors or provide any of a number of level control function. The flush mount, non-intrusive units are ideally suited when vessel size or internal clearance is limited or where protrusion into a vessel is not acceptable. All installation and servicing, including diaphragm replacement and sensitivity adjustment can be done from outside the vessel.

Jayashree RF capacitance sensors offer cost-effective, reliable point level monitoring and provide with the most affordable solution for your applications. These RF capacitance probes are designed to provide a high level of sensitivity, stability and durability for powder and bulk solids applications, as well as liquid and slurry applications and is backed by two years warranty

products.name: RF POINT LEVEL SENSOR DISK TYPE (Series SW 6201)

blocks.text: The RF Point Level Sensor is a most rugged and proven sensor for monitoring level in a chute. This is very useful for monitoring chute blockage. It is a special heavy duty disk / flange mounted probe. The probe senses only the steady level of coal lumps and does not actuate due to falling material dust or humidity. The effect of cable capacitance and drift with temperature is eliminated by using a driven shield arrangement. The controller unit operates an output relay when the coal level reaches near the sensor face. The probes are available for working temp. up to 200°C. Probes of different types are available for specific application like telescopic, Teflon coated etc..

The Ultrasonic level sensors of the Series SW 3051 are very useful for sensing high levels (up to 20 meters.) of liquids or slurry material. The sensor gives a 4-20 mA output signal to the controller and operates relays at preset high and low levels. Probes are available forsensing water levels of 5/10/15/20 meters.

Harmonics free Series Reactor (HFSR), the name derived from the electrical Standards and technology, The customised solutions offered by Jayashree brought a revolution in the motor starting concept, till date the concept stands as unmatched technology for its performance and reliability, Continuous up-gradation has improved the product with all modern requirements of system integration, data logging, control, automation, remote operation, the product is now branded and promoted with trade mark of HFSR™/FCMA™/SMSC/Rotastat/Rotacon by Jayashree.

Jayashree introduced the air core technology for soft starters in 1980’s, the first of its kind solution and invention offered for the commercial use, Air core superseded the dated magnetic core technology by its superior characteristics and performance HFSR™ ( air core and advanced magnetic core ) / FCMA™ ( auto-transformer based ) technologies are introduced and pioneered by Jayashree and promoted since 1987, both trade mark registered by JEPL, offered solutions are as per customer requirements and suitable for the application.
